evidence: The numerical mismatch reproduces, but the demonstration breaks at the required contradiction of the stated contract: these outputs explicitly have different meanings. At head ff2f79f6, skills/super-code/coordinator-workflow.md:645-657 defines the coordinator outcome as pass when matching live/pass evidence exists, requires every conflicting record remain visible, and expressly says this classification establishes evidence availability while semantic coverage and acceptance remain reviewer/caller decisions. The same section says neither path replaces run acceptance. skills/super-auto/run-state.md:270-275 separately specifies that the caller gate independently checks measurements and that contradictory pass/fail at the same tree requires reconciliation. Thus coordinator.js:351-356 and report-status:102-112 implement their respective documented contracts; the producer does not claim caller acceptance. I extracted the four relevant executable source files directly from immutable ff2f79f62cc34084c8df20edc5c2e4f201a5d630 into /tmp/ufz-pr1/judge-3-reproduce and independently ran the fixture: retained live fail plus pass for the same task/tree/command/configuration yields producer exit 0 and requiredLiveChecks[0].outcome pass, then caller exit 3, eligible false, pending sweep fail and required live check suite fail, gaps empty. A pass-only control yields producer pass and caller exit 0, eligible true. Receipts are judge-3-reproduce/producer.json, consumer.json, control-producer.json and control-consumer.json. Source checks against d84541ae confirm the new classifiers are introduced, but introduction does not make the explicitly accepted availability-versus-acceptance distinction a material gap. This is an internal semantic-contract question, not linter territory or an external-fact claim.
